title: iMobile Pay — Anil Kapoor and Rajesh Sharma

learnings.principle: Establish everyday friction within the first three seconds
learnings.application: Use a small recognisable problem to initiate the story

learnings.principle: Build humour around stubbornness or minor frustration
learnings.application: Escalate character behaviour rather than forcing exaggerated jokes

learnings.principle: Integrate celebrity talent as a story character
learnings.application: Give celebrity talent a functional role in the situation

learnings.principle: Contrast fast and slow dialogue rhythms
learnings.application: Write push-and-pull beats between energetic and grounded characters

learnings.principle: Match camera movement to character energy
learnings.application: Use framing and tracking to support emotional momentum

learnings.principle: Use authentic environments and background activity
learnings.application: Populate realistic locations with functional props and organic extras

learnings.principle: Use everyday Foley for tactile realism
learnings.application: Build the scene's sound from real actions and objects

learnings.principle: Make room for audio beat drops before punchlines
learnings.application: Reduce background sound at critical reactions or punchlines
Use a pause, blink, tilt or glance to communicate character response
Build a character pair with contrasting behaviours

learnings.principle: Show product interaction within the story
learnings.application: Demonstrate the feature in the dramatic situation

learnings.principle: Use natural phone framing and realistic compositing
learnings.application: Plan over-the-shoulder shots and practical screen tracking
